# eon_backup_posture_controls (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of backup posture controls in the Eon project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: List all backup posture controls
data "eon_backup_posture_controls" "all" {}

output "backup_posture_control_ids" {
  description = "IDs of all backup posture controls"
  value       = [for c in data.eon_backup_posture_controls.all.controls : c.id]
}

output "high_severity_controls" {
  description = "Names of HIGH severity backup posture controls"
  value = [
    for c in data.eon_backup_posture_controls.all.controls : c.name
    if c.severity == "HIGH"
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `controls` (Attributes List) List of backup posture controls. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--controls))

### Nested Schema for `controls`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Server-assigned unique identifier of the control.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the control.
- `severity` (String) Severity assigned to the control. Possible values: `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, `LOW`.
